Review.title: CustomerReview
Review.description: Real, authenticated customer review for Sai Provision & General Stores

id.description: Unique identifier for the review (matches userId for one review per user)

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the verified customer

customerName.description: Customer display name entered upon submission

locality.description: Customer area or colony in Jalgaon

status.description: Moderation status (only approved reviews are displayed publicly)

isVerifiedPurchaser.description: Only marked true if store admin explicitly verifies a real purchase

phoneNumber.description: Masked or verified phone number of the customer

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the review was created

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the review was last edited

Admin.title: StoreAdmin
Admin.description: Admin identity authorized to moderate reviews

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the store administrator

/reviews/{reviewId}.description: Collection of customer reviews with one document per verified customer (document ID is the customer's userId)
